  {δ : Type u_4} {ε : Type u_5} {x : MeasurableSpace α} {x_1 : MeasurableSpace β} {x_2 : MeasurableSpace δ}
  {x_3 : MeasurableSpace ε} [inst : MeasurableSpace γ] (κ : Kernel α β) {f : β → γ} {g : β → δ} {g' : β → ε}
  (hg : Measurable g) (hfg' : ¬Measurable fun b => (f b, g' b)) :
  (κ.map fun b => (f b, g b, g' b)).deleteMiddle = κ.map fun b => (f b, g' b) := by
  have : ¬ (Measurable (fun b ↦ (f b, g b, g' b))) := by
